body: Build 0100 (milestone). T-001: Alficén quarter/Tagus overlook, Toledo, ~1055-1088 CE. DWELLING (3-4yr) + WITNESS-LONG (29yr). 33yr total. 191ft remaining — second largest (Córdoba 412ft > Toledo 191ft > Prague 144ft). FAREWELL-B: first known, 260yr before Avignon. Gap partial: Córdoba departure ~985CE, Toledo arrival ~1055CE (70yr unresolved), Toledo departure ~1088CE. Mediterranean harbor next: ships, probable First Crusade embarkation.
title: S09E03: Toledo confirmed — 191ft, DWELLING→WITNESS-LONG→FAREWELL-B, Tyler started to stop, ships next
